title: epipactis helleborine subsp. minor
intro: Epipactis helleborine subsp. minor, commonly known as the small helleborine or marsh helleborine, is a subspecies of orchid plant that belongs to the genus Epipactis. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to treat various conditions such as respiratory issues, skin problems, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Epipactis helleborine subsp. minor are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, which may be beneficial in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
